worldcombat.skill.tailwind.summary: Raise Speed for the user and nearby allies. These increases end when the effect expires.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.use.0: Pad the whole team's Speed before a fight starts
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.use.1: Get the team moving before it is caught
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.use.2: Link allies into one line and push in together
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.description.0: Tailwind raises the Speed of the caster and allies within range by %1$s stages, lasting about %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.gale.wide: Wide gale: larger radius, but a shorter window; it spreads far and stops early.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.gale.long: Long gale: a longer window, but a smaller radius; it holds tight and lasts.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.preference.ga: Wide gale: radius x1.25, window x0.8. Long gale: window x1.35, radius x0.85. Each has its own opening.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.preference.ai: Consider raising the wind when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of raising wind; larger gives up the speed more often up close.
worldcombat.skill.tailwind.description.r: When the wind ends or is cleared, each carrier loses exactly the Speed stages it gained; a combatant already carrying the same wind is not raised again.
